tokenOwner.source: packages/seer-pm-ui-kit in the seer-pm monorepo (css/tokens.css, css/base.css, css/components.css, css/tailwind-theme.css); vendored here as vendor/seer-pm-ui-kit-0.4.0.tgz
tokenOwner.localLayer: src/index.css (@theme inline semantic colours and radii, @theme type scale, --shadow-pop, dialog animations)
tokenOwner.themeSwitch: data-theme on <html>, written by src/stores/themeStore.ts and the inline script in index.html

display.purpose: The contest question, the page H1. Held to 24ch, balanced.

title.purpose: Card headings; Subtitle on a phone.

subtitle.purpose: Card headings below 640px, one step under the 32px page heading.

lede.purpose: The live answer under the question, contest tab labels, typed amounts.

body.purpose: Document default in ink-2: table cells, descriptions, menu items.

data.purpose: Read figures: the UP price beside a bar, legend values, tooltips.

label.purpose: Uppercase 0.05em: table column headers, badges, Live and network tags. Never above a heading.

micro.purpose: Fact labels, phone-row prediction lines, footnotes.

button.purpose: The kit's button type; 13px small, 15px large.

mono.purpose: Wallet addresses, hashes and file contents only.

shadows.name: pop
shadows.purpose: Menus, popovers, tooltips, toasts and dialogs. Surfaces at rest have none.

motion.name: seer-ease-out
motion.purpose: The kit's easing for every state change.

motion.name: seer-duration-fast
motion.purpose: Colour and border changes on buttons, inputs, tabs and rows.

motion.name: prediction-tick
motion.purpose: The one authored moment: ticks ease in from the bar origin when predictions load.

motion.name: sheet-in
motion.purpose: Dialog as a bottom sheet under 640px.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animations and transitions at 0.01ms; animate-spin at 1.6s and animate-pulse at 2.4s keep running

components.name: Primary Button

narrative.overview:
Deep is a working surface for contests that price dozens of outcomes at once (98 repositories in Round 3). Its world is Electric Foundation from `@seer-pm/ui-kit`, applied as an operating app: a cool grey page, white surfaces on hairlines, Open Sans at every size, purple for the one action that matters. The reading comes before the trade. A contest page opens on its question as the page's own heading, one sentence of live answer, and who asks and resolves; then the whole field, ranked, each row carrying its two-sided reading on one bar. Any single series is detail on demand.

Density is high but calm. Rows are 14px tabular text with 16px of vertical padding, peers are separated by hairlines, and color is spent only where it means something: purple for action, green and red for the direction of a trade or a result, the kit's series colors for the identity of a followed line or a side of a pair. Everything else is the grey ramp. The app follows the reader's light or dark theme through the kit's `data-theme`, and every Deep token is a semantic name mapped onto a kit token, so both themes hold without a second palette.
keyCharacteristics: Hairline surfaces on a grey page: white cards with a 1px rule at 10px radius, no shadow at rest.
Three color meanings and no fourth: primary for action, long and short for direction, series for identity.
A two-sided reading is one bar: UP in series purple from the left, DOWN in series gold from the right, the reader's prediction as an ink tick.
Muted context lines with at most four followed series in color.
Tabular figures across the whole document; every number is printed, so color is never the only channel.
Theme-following in both directions, with one ink field (the Seer promo) and the kit footer that stay ink in both themes.

rules.name: The Kit Owns the Value Rule
rules.body: Every color in Deep is `var(--seer-*)` or a `color-mix` of two of them. A new color is a new kit token, added in the kit, never a literal in this repo.

rules.name: The Three Meanings Rule
rules.body: Purple is action, green and red are direction, series colors are identity. A series color never stands for a gain or a loss, a status color never marks a side of a pair, and purple never decorates.

rules.name: The Fixed Ink Rule
rules.body: The Seer promo and the ecosystem footer are ink in both themes. An ink field sets `data-theme="dark"` so kit controls on it take the dark tokens whatever the page theme.

rules.name: The Tabular Document Rule
rules.body: `body` sets `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`, so every price, weight, balance and rank lines up in its column and does not jitter as prices move.

rules.name: The Role Name Rule
rules.body: Sizes are chosen by role (`text-body`, `text-data`, `text-label`, `text-micro`, `text-lede`, `text-title`), not by Tailwind's numeric steps. A size outside the roles is a new role, named in `src/index.css`.

rules.name: The Shared Column Rule
rules.body: Header, content and footer share one container and one set of gutters. Nothing runs full-bleed except the footer's ink band.

rules.name: The Field in the First Screen Rule
rules.body: On a contest page, controls that sit between the brief and the field cost one line, not a padded box (the predictions toolbar is a ruled strip, not a card), so the field's first rows stay in view.

rules.name: The Hairline Surface Rule
rules.body: A surface at rest has a 1px rule and no shadow. A shadow means the element floats above the page and will go away.

rules.name: The Opaque Bar Rule
rules.body: The sticky header is opaque `paper`, never frosted: a persistent backdrop filter re-composites the page under it on every scroll.

rules.name: The Pair Bar Rule
rules.body: A two-sided reading (UP and DOWN, pass and fail) is one bar on one scale with both sides at their raw price, Series Purple from the left and Series Gold from the right. Never two separate bars, never status colors.

rules.name: The Four Followed Rule
rules.body: A chart with many series draws them all as muted context and follows at most four in color, one per series slot, in slot order. A fifth is refused, not cycled.

rules.name: The Printed Number Rule
rules.body: Color is never the only channel: every bar prints its values, every delta prints its sign, every status dot sits beside its word.

dos: Do take every color, radius, font and motion value from `@seer-pm/ui-kit` through Deep's semantic names in `src/index.css`, and change a shared value in the kit's package, never here.
Do open a contest page on its question, the live answer and who asks and resolves, then the ranked field; the trading tools follow.
Do draw a two-sided price as the Outcome Bar, with the reader's prediction as a tick on the same scale.
Do keep surfaces on 1px hairlines at 10px radius and reserve the pop shadow for things that float.
Do put solid status fills under `paper` text, not white.
Do set `data-theme="dark"` on any ink field, and read chart colors from the kit tokens on each theme change.

Do move state over 150ms on the kit's ease-out (`cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`), keep the prediction tick as the one authored motion, and let spinners and pulses keep turning (slowed) under reduced motion.
Do give a disabled action its reason in a tooltip and keep it focusable.
donts: Don't write a literal color, radius or font in a component, or redefine a `--seer-*` value in this repo.
Don't use a series color for a gain or loss, or green and red for a side of a pair.
Don't follow more than four series in color, or give every line in a field its own hue.
Don't put a shadow on a card at rest or frost the sticky header.
Don't box a toolbar or a single row as a card; peers sit on hairlines.
Don't put a small uppercase label above a heading. The label role names a column, a badge or a tag, beside or above the values it names.
Don't let a color carry a number on its own; print the value and its sign.
